test_case_name: Accept all cookies via 'ACCONSENTO' link

intents.intent: Click 'ACCONSENTO' link
And then check that all cookies are accepted and the cookie banner is dismissed

test_case_name: Reject cookies and view more options via 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link

intents.intent: Click 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link
And then check that additional cookie options are displayed

test_case_name: Close cookie banner using close button

intents.intent: Click button with id 'js-cookie-banner-close' to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Skip to main content using 'Passa al Contenuto' button

intents.intent: Click 'Passa al Contenuto' button
And then check that the focus moves to the main content section

test_case_name: Skip to menu using 'Passa al Menù' button

intents.intent: Click 'Passa al Menù' button
And then check that the focus moves to the menu section

test_case_name: Skip to footer using 'Passa al Piè di pagina' button

intents.intent: Click 'Passa al Piè di pagina' button
And then check that the focus moves to the footer section

test_case_name: Open the search bar using the search button

intents.intent: Click button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search' to open the search bar
And then check that the search input with placeholder 'Cerca' is visible

test_case_name: Perform a search using the search input and submit button

intents.intent: Click button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search' to open the search bar
Type $name into input with placeholder 'Cerca'
Click button with class 'btn-search' and data-name 'search-button' to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Navigate to the homepage using 'Homepage' link

intents.intent: Click 'Homepage' link
And then check that the homepage is loaded

test_case_name: Send an email using 'accessibilita@pec.intesasanpaolo.com' mailto link

intents.intent: Click 'accessibilita@pec.intesasanpaolo.com' link
And then check that the default email client opens with the recipient set to 'accessibilita@pec.intesasanpaolo.com'

test_case_name: Download the privacy information document via 'informativa privacy' link

intents.intent: Click 'informativa privacy' link
And then check that the document 'Informativa privacy accessibilità.docx' is downloaded or opened

test_case_name: Switch language to English using 'EN' link

intents.intent: Click 'EN' link
And then check that the page language switches to English

test_case_name: Switch language to Italian using 'Italiano' link

intents.intent: Click 'Italiano' link
And then check that the page language switches to Italian

test_case_name: Access user area via 'AREA UTENTE' button

intents.intent: Click 'AREA UTENTE' button with class 'small-copy header-top__notify-item' or 'mod--areaUtente-headerDropdown'
And then check that the user area menu is displayed

test_case_name: Login using 'Accedi' button

intents.intent: Click 'Accedi' button
And then check that the login form or authentication process is initiated

test_case_name: Logout using 'Logout' button

intents.intent: Click 'Logout' button
And then check that the user is logged out and redirected appropriately

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Contatti' page using footer link

intents.intent: Click 'Contatti' link in the footer
And then check that the 'Contatti' page is loaded

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Il mio profilo' page from user menu

intents.intent: Click 'Il mio profilo' link in the user menu
And then check that the 'Il mio profilo' page is loaded

test_case_name: Navigate to 'La Forza del Gruppo' section

intents.intent: Click 'La Forza del Gruppo' link
And then check that the 'La Forza del Gruppo' section is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Sostenibilità' section

intents.intent: Click 'Sostenibilità' link
And then check that the 'Sostenibilità' section is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Newsletter' registration page

intents.intent: Click 'Newsletter' link
And then check that the newsletter registration page is loaded

test_case_name: Download 'Modern Slavery Statement' PDF

intents.intent: Click 'Modern Slavery Statement' link
